summary: Reject reserved fixture state, store and client socket overrides outside the instance-derived paths before startup effects.

schema.detail: No claim or protocol schema changes.

rules.detail: The reserved fixture accepts only its own instance-derived state, store, database and paired client socket paths without symlink aliases.

compatibility.detail: Reserved fixture path overrides are refused with local-only-fixture-path-refused; ordinary instance path configuration is unchanged.

downtime.detail: No deployment, setup or restart is performed by this source change.

manual.detail: Fixture configuration must use its instance-derived paths before startup or exposure.

recovery.detail: Refused paths are rejected before identity or database access and require no store recovery.
